hook.first_sentence: Four dollars and sixty-five cents bought eleven hacks.

scenes.narration: Four dollars and sixty-five cents bought eleven hacks. It rode on cache the provider billed cheaper. You've got a gaming PC or a Mac, and you're eyeing tonight's download.
Here's the belief the headlines planted: the eval crowned the model, so your download is the winner. The contest was real. DeepSeek's agent got source code, a low-privilege account, and one shell.
A run only counted when the target executed a command and submitted fresh proof. The leaderboard itself warns it is not a general model ranking.
Now read the receipt. Of the two hundred sixty-eight point three million input tokens the provider counted, two hundred sixty-six point two million were cache hits.
A cache hit is input the provider already processed once, billed cheaper the second time. Nearly the whole sweep ran on re-reads.

That cheapness is a property of the serving stack, the provider's machines remembering the prompt so repeats cost less. Locally you pay in a different currency: memory to hold the weights, seconds to write each word.

What does transfer is the brain. The weights ship under an M I T license, free to use, even commercially. It's a mixture of experts, a model that wakes only a slice of itself for each word. Reading feels small. Shelving it does not.
The K V cache is the model's running notes, letting it re-read earlier words without recomputing them. Here those notes cost eight hundred ninety bytes per token. This sentence takes more room.
At home, the same bill lands on your memory.

The honest local rig is not one card. The public proof of life is four D G X Spark boxes wired together, lookup memory parked on disk. The whole weight set must sit somewhere, even the parts that sleep. Your single gaming card cannot shelve it.

Here's where the myth still holds: the open weights really are the same weights, nothing about the brain is hidden. What the eval measured was a model plus its serving stack. Your download tonight comes with only the model.
